uncited: It builds on [Tensor Approximation](5362-tensor-approximation.md) by implementing the specific n-mode product formulation of the Tucker model.
*   **Input:** A core tensor $B$ of size $R_1 \times R_2 \times R_3$, and three factor matrices $U^{(1)}$ ($I_1 \times R_1$), $U^{(2)}$ ($I_2 \times R_2$), and $U^{(3)}$ ($I_3 \times R_3$).
*   **Core Tensor $B$:** Stored as a 3D array of size $R_1 \times R_2 \times R_3$.
*   **Factor Matrices $U^{(n)}$:** Stored as 2D arrays. $U^{(1)}$ is $I_1 \times R_1$, $U^{(2)}$ is $I_2 \times R_2$, $U^{(3)}$ is $I_3 \times R_3$.
*   **Shared Memory:** Used per thread block to store slices of factor matrices and core tensors to avoid global memory latency.
The reconstruction is performed on the GPU using three successive kernel calls (TTM1, TTM2, TTM3).
One thread block is assigned per decoded brick.
*   Load $U^{(1)}$ and a slice of $B$ into shared memory.
*   Load $U^{(2)}$ and a slice of $B'$ into shared memory.
*   Load $U^{(3)}$ and a slice of $B''$ into shared memory.
*   **Memory Complexity:** The method is memory efficient.
It does not require the complete core tensor to be available in each thread.
